title: Why Caterpie Eats So Many Leaves
premise: Caterpie may devour huge amounts of leaves because it wants to grow up quickly.
audiencePromise: Watch Caterpie's enormous appetite lead from vulnerable worm to its evolution line.
openLoop: Why would a soft, weak Caterpie eat so much?
payoff: The Pokédex suggests Caterpie wants rapid growth, then it molts, makes silk, and evolves.
engagementQuestion: Metapod or Butterfree: which evolution payoff is better?

voice.instructions: Playful and quick, with real disbelief at Caterpie's appetite. Build danger around its weak body, then land the growth reveal with wonder. End on a light, genuine choice.

scenes.headline: SOFT. WEAK. ALWAYS HUNGRY.
scenes.narration: Soft and weak, Caterpie eats one hundred leaves daily.
scenes.caption: A TINY WORM WITH A MASSIVE APPETITE

scenes.headline: BIGGER THAN ITS BODY
scenes.narration: It devours leaves bigger than its own 0.3-meter body.
scenes.caption: LEAVES BIGGER THAN CATERPIE

scenes.headline: IT OFTEN BECOMES PREY
scenes.narration: Bird Pokémon attack it, and it often becomes their prey.
scenes.caption: SOFT, WEAK, AND SEEN AS FOOD

scenes.headline: IT MAY BE RUSHING
scenes.narration: The Pokédex suggests it wants to grow up quickly.
scenes.caption: ITS APPETITE MAY BE A RUSH TO GROW

scenes.headline: SILK TO BUTTERFREE
scenes.narration: It molts, covers itself with silk, then becomes Metapod and Butterfree.
scenes.caption: CATERPIE → METAPOD → BUTTERFREE

scenes.headline: METAPOD OR BUTTERFREE?
scenes.narration: Metapod or Butterfree: which evolution payoff is better?
scenes.caption: COCOON POWER OR BUTTERFLY GLORY?
